lines.1: 「You know the heroine in that baseball manga? She's top of her year, sweet, popular with everyone, and the moment she tries a sport, she reaches the national level.」
lines.2: 「I've always wondered how anyone could write a heroine that ridiculously unrealistic... but now I might be willing to believe one could exist.」
lines.4: 「Yoppi. She's so sweet you can't help wanting to tease her, she's cute, she's got a great figure, and she's athletic.」
